# Frozen baseline: Russian plural labels of all MDO collections that HBK
# classifies as Global-context properties at the time of Phase C landing.
#
# This file is a regression pin only. It catches accidental removal or
# rename of any of the 17 known MDO plurals in either:
#   - the HBK extractor (`crates/bsl-platform/data/platform_data.json`); or
#   - `MdoType::from_plural` (`crates/bsl-metadata/src/metadata_object.rs`).
#
# It does NOT auto-detect a new MDO plural added to HBK without a matching
# `MdoType` variant. Sync-gap discovery is procedural: when
# `platform_data.json` is regenerated, follow the workflow in
# `crates/bsl-platform/data/PROVENANCE.md` to review new global-context
# properties whose declared type ends in `<X>Менеджер` / `<X>Manager`. If
# any are MDO collections, extend `MdoType::all()` and refresh this file
# in the same commit.
#
# Empty lines and `#`-prefixed lines are ignored. One label per line.
